@movie ig! good morning! I'm really glad you asked about my tragic backstory because it's rare that people do, and really brave and honest of you to open your heart to me ❤️ It all started when I was a little girl. I was always a tomboy, but back when I was 7 we didn't have words like "carpet muncher" and "lezzie" so I just had to settle for "young prodigy" and "girl genius". My best friend growing up and I did everything together, and we were really close in the way that two girls are when one of them is questioning and one of them is completely oblivious. One day she invited me over to the movies. We were both 13. I was clueless, but she was intent on confessing to me. We went to go see Twilight, and in the middle of it, she looked to me with a twizzler in her mouth and asked me to share it with her, lady and the tramp style. I, foolishly, declined-- I didn't realize at the time, and wanted to focus on the movie. Crushed by my rejection, she decided to try and finish the twizzler herself-- a fatal mistake it turned out, because she choked on it and died just as Edward and Bella were having their moment and no one in the theater noticed until it was too late I've been afraid of concession candy ever since, but this season means so much to me for so many reasons. The fact that it's my first time playing an org in like two years, AND it's on Concession Cove?? It's truly time to face my fears. The fact that I got assigned Twizzler tribe just makes it make sense: this is my destiny. My time to overcome the adversity of unknowing teenage yuri and embrace my legacy as a Grown Ass Lesbian. (while I'm saying this it smash cuts to a montage of every time I've ever said "my wife" in this server)

Sam 5/18/2025 1:25 AM
Grace and I got to chat a lot today and I feel like we're both on the same page. That said, she feels very green and the timezone difference may be kinda rough for socializing with other people. I hope it doesn't bite her in the ass and if/when we make it to swap she's able to hold her own without me S8n is very chill and I quite like him, he's a very good and smart player though and is probably just as analytical about everything as me. I'm choosing now to not look at him as a threat I need to beat but instead someone I would be willing to lose to if it ever came to it-- I could see him easily making it to the end. I don't think he views me the same way though (as someone he would concede a win to). I got to talk a little bit more to Activ today but it was pretty skin deep conversation. I need to invest more into talking to them I think because him I think because he seems like a pretty easy vote to sway from preliminary chatting. Shinx and I talked a little in VC and they certainly gave some strong insight into their history-- I am still wary of them, they seem like a pretty volatile social threat early on and not someone I see myself working with long term right now, but can work with in the short term Ghoody I think is my most suspicious vote right now. Villain of the season when they played in whatever smorg season he was in (I already forgot) and overall not the most social with me, but I see him alone with s8n a lot. I need to keep my standing with s8n very good and I think cutting him early is the way to do that-- I don't think any of the other tribe members will be much of a threat to me+s8n+grace.

Sam 6/1/2025 1:38 PM
Grace and I finally talked FTC plans today. Right now our contenders to bring with us are Shinx and Scosh, maybe Gnocchi depending on how things go. We also were very straight forward about how we plan to make our cases against each other, she intends to make a "she's a loud player and I cleaned up her messes" and I intend to make a "I was a major factor in every vote that happened in this game and most of Grace's info came from me". We also agree that standing side by side at FTC is our goal not just for game reasons but personal, and if either of us win it counts as a win for the other. Shinx has been thrown UTB by me a lot the last 24 hours. I really want to hinder his social growth and make sure he can't latch on to anyone else. He would be great to bring to FTC because I strongly feel like I can make a strong argument against him, especially with hindering his growth early on by telling everyone he was pro twizzlers all the way. Scosh is the sweetest but has been very UTR the last couple of days, I want to bring them with me because I don't want to vote them but also because I really don't think they have a case. I don't want to bring them because they said they've been the goat 4 games previously. I don't want to do that to them again. Gnocchi has been VERY straight forward with game talk after the initial hump and vibes are immaculate. Grace wants to consider bringing him as our third but I don't know. I think there's a lot cooking under the surface, but I do trust him. Shthe has also been a little MIA but I do ultimately trust him. He was the first to point out that Tim and Leaf were probably trying to manipulate me and has been very forthright with information. I trust our alliance of TCS and where it will go. However, I think he will have a very strong case standing at the end with me and Grace, so I'm not sure if I can bring him all the way. Poor S8n is in a really sticky spot. He felt he had to beg for his life on nachos and probably feels like he needs to beg for his life to pretzels. At the time of writing I am very wary of him, but willing to give him the benefit of the doubt. He and I will be talking later today in which I will dump everything. Unfortunately though there is no way I win against him if I bring him to the end. It can't happen. Hydro has nothing no game talk and no way to breach it. Apparently he's close with leaf. We will see how things go. Leaf is a guy of all time. Incredibly charismatic and I can see why he was the power player on Nacho. I need to get him out ASAP, I can be the only power player. Tim is the one that confuses me the most. He seems genuine with his information sharing but I know he isn't. I don't trust him just as much as leaf, and I think he's even a bigger threat because he will let leaf make his big plays. He's maybe the grace in this situation where I'm leaf? In any case, he's my vote target.
